title: Mike LaFleur: I don't buy narrative that you can't evaluate Carson Beck in current offense

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike LaFleur: I don't buy narrative that you can't evaluate Carson Beck in current offense
sources.description: The Cardinals are set to start Carson Beck at quarterback for the rest of the season and the rookie's performance over the remaining seven games will play a role in how the team approaches the offseason.
